title.narrative: Contributing to the restoration of confidence, security, peace and reconciliation in Burundi

description.narrative: This proposed project seeks to restore a spirit of confidence within the population. It’s planned to focus both on Burundian refugees living in camps in DRC, Rwanda and Tanzania as well as beneficiaries living in-country especially the youths mostly affected by this crisis. The restoration of peace, security and true reconciliation requires the participation of all stakeholders including women and youths in particular. Project aims also to take advantage of women leading role in the current conflict in Burundi to get them strongly involved in restoring enable peace. Thereby, a “Women of Faith” network supported by Burundian episcopal justice and peace commission (CEJP Burundi) already operational in the field of search for peace carry out solidarity visits to Burundians refugee camps in DRC, Tanzania and Rwanda to inquire women most problems, their views and propositions for restoring peace. The data that will be collected in these visits will serve in drafting the advocacy paper with relevant targets.
